## The text

- **ADR-0123 D2:** "Under `group`, no organization scope means an empty membership set."
- **The runtime after PR #24819:** that sentence describes the scope pre-test only. A union-scope insert from a session with no active organization is refused too, with the same D2 `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, because a new row lands in the active organization (ADR-0105 D5). Reads still span the membership set, and updates and deletes of member-organization rows are unchanged.
